decisions.reason: Adjustable cardboard quarter pallet builds directly on the firm's existing cardboard display knowledge and can be improved through internal R&D.
Cardboard display with pegboard back is an incremental extension of known cardboard display capabilities, enabling easy interpretation and improvement.
Standard cardboard quarter pallet display is highly related to core paperboard competencies and thus easily assimilated.
Eighth pallet cardboard display is a size variation within the firm's established cardboard display knowledge.
Wooden display pallet sits outside the firm's paper/cardboard core, limiting absorptive capacity to recognize, assimilate, and improve the product.
Cardboard quarter-pallet for media products remains within the firm's core cardboard display domain and can be refined with existing knowledge.
